📖 How to Play

🏗️ Building

Go to the Buildings tab. Click a building card to construct it if you have enough resources. Each building produces resources, provides housing, or boosts stats. Double-click a building you own to upgrade it (up to Level 3).

▶ Advancing

Click Next Day to advance one day. Each day, your buildings produce resources, villagers may arrive or leave, and random events may occur. Survive as long as you can!

👥 Villagers

Build houses to increase your population cap. Villagers arrive when you have housing and decent happiness. Keep them happy or they'll leave!

🔬 Research

Spend research and knowledge on the Research tab to unlock new technologies, bonuses, and buildings.

⚖️ Laws

Enact laws to boost stats or change gameplay. Some laws have trade-offs — read the effects carefully!

📜 Quests

Quests refresh daily. Complete them for rewards like gold, knowledge, and resources!

💱 Trade

Trade surplus resources for gold or other resources you need on the Trade tab.

⚔️ Units

Recruit military units to defend your village from raids and bandit attacks.

🎮 Sandbox

Enter the Konami Code (↑↑↓↓←→←→ B A) to toggle Sandbox Mode — unlimited resources and all techs. A special pause chime plays when activated!

💾 Saving

Use Save or enable Auto-Save to persist your village. Export/Import lets you share saves.

⬆️ Leveling

Your village gains XP from building, researching, and surviving. Level up to earn rewards and new titles!

⚠️ Watch Out!

Keep food, health, and happiness above zero. Watch out for disasters (typhoons, earthquakes, plagues). Build defences and preventive buildings to stay safe!
